title: PackedScene
key_points: PackedScene is an abstraction of a serialized scene.
It provides access to operations and checks that can be performed on the scene resource itself.
Can be used to save a node to a file.
The method instantiate() triggers a Node.NOTIFICATION_SCENE_INSTANTIATED notification on the root node.
limitations: Only available in editor builds for some methods.
asserts: PackedScene provides an interface to load and manipulate serialized scenes.
scope: The context of asserting is related to loading, saving and manipulating scene files in Godot game engine.
